programs.title: Drive Presents
programs.desc: This two-part TV special examines Australia's SUV craze through Mazda's CX-60 and CX-90, highlighting the vehicles' alignment with the adventurous Aussie spirit. This episode delves into the SUVs' engineering and harmony with landscapes.

programs.title: Salvage Hunters
programs.desc: In Suffolk, Drew goes on a spending spree when he finds antiques imported from France. Later, in Lancashire, he falls in love with a piece of bamboo furniture.

programs.title: Tanked
programs.desc: Wayde and Brett take a look at the current state of some of their greatest tanks, a fire at a Malibu Winery causes damage to their outdoor aquarium and jackass producer Jeff Tremaine is having troubles with his eels.

programs.title: Wheeler Dealers World Tour
programs.desc: Mike and Elvis take on one of their toughest challenges yet: can they make an Audi RS 6 estate car faster than a sports car? Mike reckons he's found one that could be a bargain, but Elvis isn't so sure when it almost crashes.

programs.title: Opal Hunters: Red Dirt Road Trip
programs.desc: In the final week of their trip, the race to reach $40,000 each is down to the wire on Rod and JC's epic red dirt road trip. They strike it big mining giant garnet clusters before embarking on a treasure-hunting mission.

programs.title: The Grand Tour
programs.desc: Jeremy, Richard and James pay tribute to one of the bedrocks of British life, the medium-sized Ford saloon, starting with the Cortina of the 1960s and '70s, moving onto the Sierra of the '80s and ending with the Mondeo.
